name: Seafile
author: haiwen
description: The Drive: file sync between laptop, phone and this box, plus a web UI, with desktop and mobile clients. Seafile plus MariaDB and Redis on a Docker network; only the web tier is published, on 127.0.0.1:8081. Camera upload stays off here on purpose — Immich owns photos, so nothing is stored twice. Also the destination manimkc uploads its finished videos to.
